title: Tenant changed
description: The full current state of one Tenant, carried by a state-transfer event. A consumer upserts the row when `version` is newer than the stored one, so a replica can merge events and a snapshot in any order. The reserved platform pseudo-tenant (00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001) is published too, because platform-scope jobs need it. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

code.description: The Tenant code, unique across the suite.

version.description: The aggregate's optimistic-lock version; a consumer drops an event older than the row it holds.
